meta_desc: A-Level Geography adventure on carbon fluxes, photosynthesis, respiration and human emissions.
final_note: Humans add ~10 Gt/yr; nature recycles ~120 Gt/yr.

concepts.def: Plants fix ~120 Gt C/yr from atmosphere into biomass.
Living organisms release ~120 Gt C/yr; near-balance with photosynthesis.
Burning fossil fuels and biomass; ~10 Gt C/yr anthropogenic.

walkthroughs.body_html: Photosynthesis fixes ~120 Gt/yr; balanced by respiration and decomposition. Ocean-atmosphere flux ~90 Gt/yr each way. Volcanism is minor ~0.1 Gt/yr. Without humans, net atmospheric stock varies on Milankovitch timescales of tens of thousands of years.

Fossil fuel combustion 9.5 Gt C/yr (2022); cement production 1.6 Gt; land-use change 1.1 Gt. Total ~12 Gt/yr added to short-cycle. About 50 percent absorbed by land and ocean sinks; remaining 50 percent stays in atmosphere causing CO2 to rise ~2.5 ppm/yr.

Ocean sink absorbs ~2.9 Gt C/yr but warmer water holds less CO2; sink may weaken. Land sink absorbs ~3.0 Gt/yr via CO2 fertilisation and regrowth. Future projections: Amazon and boreal forests may transition from sinks to sources by 2050 under high emissions scenarios.
